Commentary.Commentary: That brings us to the end of the coverage of this game. The Indian team's Republic Day party has been gatecrashed here in Kanpur. The action now shifts to Nagpur where the teams will battle it out in the second T20I. Can the Indians fight back or will England seal the deal there? The action starts on 29th January at 1900 local, 1330 GMT. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Moeen Ali says that as a unit they were fantastic and the next two matches are going to be massive. Says that he learned from the ODIs and adjusted his lines and lengths accordingly.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that their bowlers were excellent. Applauds Moeen Ali for bowling such a great spell on a pitch where there wasn't any turn on offer. Also lauds the other bowlers. Adds that getting off to a flier upfront helped the rest as it allowed them to come in and settle. Ends by saying that it's always nice to see young players stepping up and would like to continue the momentum going forward.

India skipper, Virat Kohli accepts that England played better than India and were very precise in whatever they did tonight. Credits English bowlers for making full use of the pitch to trouble the Indian batsmen. Admits that they fell around 30-35 run short and also lauds the opposition batsmen for keeping their composure under lights. Appreciates Chahal's performance tonight by saying that he is a wicket-taker and that he was the one who pulled India back in the game. Ends by saying that T20 is a game which one has to enjoy and play at a certain level of intensity.

Chahal was the only Indian bowler who had a good outing while the others all copped a lot of stick. There wasn't enough runs on the board but the Indian bowlers never tried enough, often faltering in their lengths. Full marks to England's bowlers who did their homework well earlier in the afternoon to restrict India to a below par score. Back-to-back wins for England on the tour now after the ODI win in Kolkata.

A clinical performance by England to go 1-0 up in the 3-match T20I series. The tourists got a brisk start in pursuit of the modest target but both openers departed in the same over to Chahal to give India a glimmer of hope. Skipper Morgan though ensured that there was no comeback for the hosts as he rattled a blistering fifty. His partnership with Root virtually sealed the game for England. The captain departed at the brink but Root and Stokes completed the formalities.
That will do! As easy as it gets. Full toss on off, whipped away down to long on for a single. Comprehensive victory for the visitors. ENGLAND WIN BY 7 WICKETS.
Full toss on middle and leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Full toss on off, Root picks it up cleanly this time and whips it uppishly with ease over mid-wicket to find the fence. Clean strike and just 2 runs needed now for the visitors.

FOUR! UP AND OVER! Slower ball on middle, Root looks to loft it over mid on but gets it off the toe end of the bat. Still has enough bat on it to clear the infield as the ball races to the fence. Just a hit away are England now.
Fuller outside off, Root fails to get his bat down in time.

Shortish on middle, Root stays back and pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket. Chahal makes a sliding half-stop to his left and gathers himself just in time to collect the ball near the ropes. A brace taken.
Shortish and angled away outside off, Root tries to pull but gets a bottom edge towards third man. Rasool makes a tumbling stop near the ropes to keep the batsmen to a couple.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Stokes was stepping out to flick but misses. Wide signaled and the batsmen cross too as Dhoni fumbles.
ASHISH NEHRA is back. Just 16 needed from 18.
Good length on middle, gets back and blocks it to the leg side.
Nothing from the free hit as Root is cleaned up. Tries the premeditated paddle off a full toss but ends up scooping it on to the stumps.
Free hit coming up.

REPRIEVE FOR ROOT! Length ball angled in around off, Root looks to heave it away but the ball shoots through low to rip out the off pole. The umpire goes upstairs to check for the no ball and it's tragedy for Bumrah as he has overstepped. Not that a wicket would have mattered much at this stage but still. Free Hit coming up.
Root has been bowled. They are checking for the no ball.
Fuller outside off, gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Looked comical. Back of a length around off, punched off the back foot towards short cover. Root wanted the single but is sent back. Too late but Kohli's throw hits the batsman at the bowler's end. A direct hit would have got Joe.
Good length around off, gets across and jams it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back on.
Tossed up outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks well.
Floated outside off, pushed down the ground to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Stokes looks to push at it but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, whipped off the back foot through mid on for a single.
BEN STOKES walks out to bat.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! One shot too many from the England captain but he has done his job. Fuller outside off, Morgan eyes a biggie over long off but doesn't get the distance on the stroke. Raina stationed near the ropes takes a very simple catch. Ends a top knock from Eoin, he has put England on the brink of a series lead. MAIDEN T20I wicket for Rasool. Just 22 needed from 28.
8th T20I fifty for Eoin Morgan!

SIX! BLASTED AWAY! What a way to get to the milestone! Another half-tracker served up to Morgan and he obliges. Pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a massive maximum. Excellent counterattacking knock from the skipper.
Floated on middle, nudged on the leg side for a single.
Flatter on middle, Root clips it through square leg for a single.
Drifting in on middle, Morgan tucks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

EXCELLENT FROM RAINA! Technically a dropped chance but he has prevented a maximum there. Floated outside off, Morgan goes for the slog sweep over mid-wicket. Raina takes the catch but realizes that the momentum is taking him past the ropes. Quickly parries the ball back into play just before falling into the ropes. They check it upstairs but it has been brilliantly done by Raina. Brace taken by the batsmen.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot past the covers for a single.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is back to bowl his final over. Just 34 needed from 36.
Floated on middle and leg, worked on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, punched towards long off for a single.
SIX! LAUNCHED! No stopping Morgan in this mood. On a length outside off, he gets across and flicks it elegantly over mid-wicket for a maximum. Lovely timing on the stroke.
Fuller on middle, gets across and worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, worked off the back foot towards long on
Floated outside off, steps out and punches it down to long off for a single.
PARVEZ RASOOL is back on.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to long on for a single.
Shortish outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
That was very close! Length ball outside off, comes in sharply as Root is beaten on the inside edge. That wasn't far away from the off pole. Dhoni fumbles and allows a bye.

FOUR! POOR FROM KOHLI AGAIN! Root was giving the charge and slaps the length ball towards cover where Virat lets it through. It goes towards the fence for a boundary. This is the last thing India need in a situation like this. Unusually bad day for Kohli in the field today.
Back of a length on middle, Root goes for the big pull but gets struck on the thigh as the ball rolls to short third man. Wanted the single, Morgan sends him back.
Length ball on leg stump, whipped towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dug in short on middle, very high and that's a wide for height.
Floated on a length on off, worked past mid-wicket for a single.
50-run partnership between Root and Morgan off 48 deliveries!
Flatter on middle, punched off the back foot just past the bowler towards long on for a single. Excellent stand this for England after those two quick wickets.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards mid off for a single.

SIX! SMACKED! That made a cracking sound off the bat. Flatter and dragged halfway down the track outside off, Morgan stands tall and clobbers it way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. What a strike! England are coasting at the moment.
Fuller on the pads, gets across and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, Root plays the reverse sweep towards third man for a brace.
SURESH RAINA is back on.
Good length outside off, steered down towards third man for a single.
Good length around off, Morgan pushes at it but gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single.
Length ball outside off, keeps a touch low as Morgan steps out for the big heave. Gets a faint under edge that goes on the bounce to Dhoni.
Good length on off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, Root shuffles across to flick but is hit on the pads. Muted lbw appeal which is turned down. The ball rolls to square leg as they take a couple of leg byes.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
HARDIK PANDYA comes on to bowl.
Beaten again! Leg spinner wide outside off, spinning away, Root once again fails to connect his sweep. Still a good over for England, 12 runs off it! They require 72 off 60 deliveries now!
Beaten! Tossed up wide outside off, spinning away, JR looks to drag-sweep it but misses.
Sensible from the skipper! Full delivery, eased on the leg side for a single.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Morgan kneels and slog sweeps it over square leg for a maximum. That will release the pressure which was building up!
Shortish delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Great piece of timing on it! Tossed up on off, Root dances down and drives it through covers. Finds the gap and beats Pandya in the deep. Just what the doctor ordered for England!
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is brought back on!
Pitched on a length outside off, Root defends it with soft hands to short cover for a quick single. Just a couple off the over!
Length delivery outside off, tapped to covers. Another dot!
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Good running from Root! Length delivery angling across, Morgan looks to run it down but gets it off the bottom edge just beside the stumps. Root calls through for a quick single and completes it.
Stifled lbw appeal! Angling towards the pads, Morgan misses his flick and is rapped up on the pads. The Indians appeal but its turned down as it was pitched outside leg.
Length delivery on leg, angling across, defended from within the crease back to the bowler.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is back on!
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
On middle and leg, another single to long on.
Sliding into the pads, eased on to long on for a single.
Sliding in on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Outside off, driven to long off for a single.
SURESH RAINA is now into the attack!
Tossed up on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Fuller on the pads, clipped through backward square leg. Nehra is the one chasing it and the batsmen take a couple of runs with ease.
Short again, punched off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Sliding into the pads, flicked off the pads through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Superb placement! Tossed up outside off, Morgan goes inside out over covers. The ball crosses the fence on one bounce. A boundary is signalled!
Sliding in, punched off the back foot to covers.

Googly outside leg, spinning away, Morgan looks to play it across the line but gets it off the leading edge past first slip for a single. After a high-flying start in the first three overs, India concede only 12 runs and pick up 2 wickets in the next three. 48/2 at the end of Powerplay!
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, Morgan defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Root gets down the track and gets himself yorked. Digs it out to short leg.
Short delivery, dragged in front of square on the leg side for a single. Another tight over, just 3 from it!
Flatter outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Sliding in, Morgan stays back and defends it with a straight bat.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Root gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks on the bounce.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
PARVEZ RASOOL is brought on from the other end now!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Good over for India, 7 runs and a couple of wicket off it!
EOIN MORGAN replaces Billings!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Both the openers are now back in the hut! Billings dances down the track, Chahal zips it through. Billings is beaten by the pace and the ball goes through between his bat and pad as he looks to whip it. Chahal is delighted and why won't he be! India back in the game!
Another misfield from Kohli! Tossed up outside off, spinning away, pushed through covers. Kohli once again misfields and gives away a single.
On middle and off, turned to mid-wicket.
JOE ROOT walks in at no. 3!

OUT! Spin does the trick for India! Chahal has his revenge after being hit for six on his very first ball! Leg spinner outside off, Roy looks to drive it. But, gets it off the inside edge, onto the pads and then onto the stumps. Roy is disappointed with that!
SIX! Tossed up around off, Roy kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. The ball sails into the stands. India hit just one maximum in their 20 overs, England have already hit their third!
Spin is introduced as YUZVENDRA CHAHAL comes into the attack!
Banged in short outside off, Roy walks ahead a touch and drags it just front of square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery angling in, worked with soft hands through widish mid on for a quick single.
Angling into the pads, flicked through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Angling down leg, Roy leaves it watchfully.
Low bounce! Nehra comes from around the wicket. Pitches it outside off, keeps a touch low and the ball goes past under the Roy's bat as he looks to cut it.
The ball seems to be stuck inside the sightscreen. Replacement one comes out.
SIX! Some shot that! Full and angling away, Roy goes through with his backlift as he lofts it over long off for a maximum. Second one off the innings!
On the pads, tucked through forward square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary. Great over for England. 20 overs off it!
Outside off, tapped to point.
SIX! Innovation at its best! Full on middle and off, SB kneels and scoops it over fine leg. Clears the rope with ease and that's a maximum.
On a length and angling away, Sam guides it past backward point and takes a couple for it.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route! Length delivery on leg, Billings clears his front leg and mistimes his half-pull just wide of mid on for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries!
FOUR! Fuller length outside off, Billings slices it over Chahal at cover-point. He jumps to his highest but can't get to it and the ball reaches to the fence behind. First boundary off the innings.
JASPRIT BUMRAH to bowl from the other end!
Pitched outside off, Sam bends his knees and guides it past first slip to third man for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to cover-point.
Outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers, this time Virat stops it.
Oh dear! Misfield from the skipper! Full outside off, driven through covers. Kohli at short extra cover lets it go through between his legs and concedes couple.
On the pads, Roy clips it to mid on. Chahal is stationed a touch deep there and Billings wants a single but Roy sends him back.
Welcome back for the chase. Unless India get a good start, this game could be a cakewalk chase for England.
